name: Creekside Campground
note: Wooded campground on Stony Creek in Edinburg, in the Shenandoah Valley off I-81; 36 sites, W/E/S, some along the creek. Off-creek W/E/S $47.39, creekside $52.65 (rates as posted). RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$42/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.3 over 344 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: creeksidecampgroundva.com rates (read 2026-09-30): W/E/S Off Creek $47.39, Creekside $52.65, Prime $57.92, Super $63.18 -> real transient RV campground; published base $47.39 (2026) <= $50; RV Life 4.5* over 262 reviews
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 38.8201,-78.5637: the campground lies in the wooded strip along Stony Creek south of town, sites under canopy within ~30 m of the bank; the operator sells a distinct 'Creekside' site class (sites 15-26) at a premium, which is the confirmation canopy can't give

name: Deer Run Campground
